title: Rain on a Cabin Roof and a Crackling Fireplace for Sleep - No Thunder | 8 Hours
description:
8 hours of heavy rain on a log cabin roof with a crackling fireplace beside you. No thunder, no music, no talking. The fire pops and crackles close by while the rain keeps a steady rhythm overhead, then the fire slowly dies down in the last minutes.
The sound never loops. Made for deep sleep, reading and quiet evenings.

0:00:00 Rain and fire begin
7:45:00 The fire slowly dies down
